# regressions
                visual  ~ textual
                speed  ~ textual
lavaan create relation automatically  between visual and speed  (visual <->speed ) in model

There is nothing wrong with estimating residual correlations.  If you actually expect the visual-speed correlation to be completely accounted for by their correlations with textual, then you can test that assumption by fixing the residual variance to zero.  See the lavaan tutorial pages for how to specify covariance parameters

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/syntax1.html

and how to fix a parameter to a specific value (in your case, 0)

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/syntax2.html

Terry
